# c-script (Link Language) — Complete LLM Specification & Developer Reference

This document is optimized for LLMs (Grok, Claude, GPT, DeepSeek) and developers using AI assistants like Cursor or Windsurf.

---

## 1. Syntax & Grammar Overview

### File Extension and Binaries
- Source files: `.link`
- CLI binary: `linkc` (also available via `npx link-lang`)

### Types and Primitives
| c-script Type | TypeScript Type | JSON Wire Format | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Int` | `number` | integer number | 32-bit signed |
| `Float` | `number` | float number | 64-bit IEEE 754 |
| `Int64` | `string` | string | Safe 64-bit integer without precision loss |
| `String` | `string` | string | UTF-8 |
| `Bool` | `boolean` | boolean | `true` or `false` |
| `Timestamp` | `string` | ISO-8601 string | Millisecond UTC timestamp (`now()`) |
| `Void` | `void` | `null` / empty | Return type of non-returning RPCs |
| `T[]` | `T[]` | JSON array | List/Array of items |
| `Map<K, V>` | `Record<K, V>` | JSON object | Key-value map |
| `(A, B)` | `[A, B]` | JSON tuple array | Heterogeneous tuple |
| `T?` | `T \| null` | `null` or value | Nullable type |
| `field?: T` | `field?: T` | key omitted | Optional object property |

### Type Definitions & Enums
```rust
// Struct
type User = {
  id: Int,
  name: String,
  email: String,
  role: Role,
  createdAt: Timestamp,
  avatar?: String,
}

// Simple Enum -> TypeScript String Union ("Admin" | "Member" | "Guest")
enum Role {
  Admin,
  Member,
  Guest,
}

// Discriminated / Tagged Union (ADT)
enum ApiResult<T, E> {
  Ok { data: T },
  Err { code: Int, error: E },
}
```

### Functions & Closures
```rust
// Internal helper function (not exposed as RPC)
fn calculateDiscount(total: Float, vip: Bool) -> Float {
  if vip {
    total * 0.8
  } else {
    total
  }
}

// Inline closure
let isEven = |n: Int| -> Bool { n % 2 == 0 };
```

---

## 2. Services, RPCs, and Streaming

Services define public API endpoints. Each method in a `service` is automatically exposed as an HTTP POST RPC and mapped to TypeScript client methods.

```rust
service Products {
  // RPC with default parameter value
  rpc list(limit: Int = 50) -> Product[] {
    db.products.all()
  }

  rpc get(id: Int) -> Product? {
    db.products.find(id)
  }

  // Authentication & RBAC Decorators
  @authenticated
  rpc create(input: NewProduct) -> Product {
    db.products.insert(Product {
      id: 0,
      title: input.title,
      price: input.price,
      createdAt: now(),
    })
  }

  @requires(Role.Admin)
  rpc delete(id: Int) -> Bool {
    db.products.delete(id)
  }

  // Real-time Push Stream (Server-Sent Events)
  stream watch() -> Product {
    while true {
      db.products.subscribe()
    }
  }
}
```

---

## 3. Database Persistence (`db { ... }`)

Declaring a `db` block configures an embedded SQLite database with schema auto-generation.

```rust
db {
  products: Product[],
  users: User[],
}
```

### Database Methods on `db.<collection>`
- `db.<col>.all() -> T[]`
- `db.<col>.find(id: Int) -> T?`
- `db.<col>.insert(item: T) -> T` (Auto-increments `id`)
- `db.<col>.applyPatch(id: Int, patch: Partial<T>) -> T?`
- `db.<col>.delete(id: Int) -> Bool`
- `db.<col>.findWhere(predicate: |item: T| -> Bool) -> T[]`
- `db.<col>.deleteWhere(predicate: |item: T| -> Bool) -> Int`
- `db.<col>.subscribe() -> T` (Yields when row is inserted, patched, or deleted)

---

## 4. Testing Framework (`test "..." { ... }`)

The built-in test runner provides zero-dependency behavioral assertions and snapshot testing with isolated in-memory databases per test.

```rust
test "inserting and fetching product" {
  let created = Products.create(NewProduct {
    title: "Mechanical Keyboard",
    price: 99.99,
  });
  assert(created.id > 0, "id generated");

  let fetched = Products.get(created.id);
  assert(fetched != null, "product exists");
  assert(fetched.price == 99.99, "price matches");
}
```

Commands:
- `linkc test backend.link` (Runs behavioral tests)
- `linkc test backend.link backend.link.snap [--update]` (Contract snapshot diff testing)

---

## 5. Generated TypeScript Client Consumption

`linkc build backend.link src/gen` generates:
- `contract.d.ts`: Exact TypeScript types.
- `client.ts`: Typed RPC client with async iterables for streams.
- `validators.ts`: Runtime payload validators.
- `hooks.ts`: React hooks.
- `openapi.json`: OpenAPI v3 specification.
- `zod.ts`: Zod schemas for external tools.

### Example TypeScript Usage:
```typescript
import { createClient } from './gen/client';
import type { Product } from './gen/contract';

const client = createClient({ baseUrl: 'http://localhost:8787' });

// Set Bearer token for @authenticated / @requires endpoints
client.setToken('session-token-128bit');

// Call RPC
const products = await client.Products.list({ limit: 10 });

// Listen to Realtime SSE Stream
for await (const product of client.Products.watch({})) {
  console.log("Realtime product change:", product);
}
```

---

## 6. CLI Toolchain Summary

| Subcommand | Syntax | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `build` | `linkc build <file.link> <outdir>` | Generates TS contracts, client, validators, and OpenAPI |
| `test` | `linkc test <file.link>` | Executes integrated behavioral test runner |
| `serve` | `linkc serve <file.link> [port]` | Starts HTTP API server with embedded SQLite |
| `dev` | `linkc dev <file.link> <outdir> [port]` | Interactive watch mode with auto-rebuild & server restart |
| `new` | `linkc new <name>` | Scaffolds a new c-script project |
| `fmt` | `linkc fmt <file.link> [--check]` | Formats source code according to canonical style |
| `lint` | `linkc lint <file.link> [--fix]` | Analyzes code quality and unused variables |
| `doc` | `linkc doc <file.link> [outdir]` | Generates interactive HTML documentation |
| `docker`| `linkc docker <file.link> [outdir]`| Generates production multi-stage Dockerfile and compose |
| `lsp` | `linkc lsp` | Starts Language Server Protocol over stdio for VS Code / Cursor |
